literature_notes: All five ledger lines (L1–L5) describe the same experimental system from PMC8477538: C-terminal in-frame fusion of AcGFP/HA or Strep/FLAG tags to the DLL1 C-terminus. The DLL1 C-terminus (residue 723) lies within the intracellular domain (residues 567–723), so these tags are on the cytoplasmic face, not the extracellular face. No ledger line describes a tag at the mature N-terminus (after signal-peptide cleavage at residue 17, mature N-terminus = Q18), in any extracellular loop, or anywhere in the extracellular domain (residues 18–545). Because the ledger contains no evidence of a tolerated insertion on the extracellular face, zero sites are proposed. The C-terminal intracellular tag is recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: AcGFP/HA and Strep/FLAG tags fused in-frame to the DLL1 C-terminus (residue 723) are tolerated in CHO cells and transgenic mice, but the C-terminus is intracellular (topology: 567–723 cytoplasmic), so this is not an extracellular surface tag site.
